items.exampleEn: My desktop is full of icons, so I can never find anything.
items.exampleZh: 我的電腦桌面滿是圖示，所以我老是找不到東西。

items.exampleEn: Visitors can browse the museum's old photos on its website.
items.exampleZh: 訪客可以在博物館的網站上瀏覽它的老照片。

items.exampleEn: The newspaper publicized the problem, and the city fixed the road quickly.
items.exampleZh: 報紙把這個問題公開報導，市政府很快就修好了那條路。

items.exampleEn: All the tickets are now sold electronically, so there are no paper tickets.
items.exampleZh: 現在所有的票都以電子方式販售，所以沒有紙本票。

items.exampleEn: Our team chose Lisa as the presenter for the sales meeting.
items.exampleZh: 我們團隊選了 Lisa 擔任業務會議的報告人。

items.exampleEn: Scientists collected data on the sea temperature for ten years.
items.exampleZh: 科學家花了十年收集海水溫度的數據。

items.exampleEn: The cable for my phone is too short to reach the bed.
items.exampleZh: 我手機的線太短，搆不到床邊。

items.exampleEn: My boss returned the draft with red notes all over it.
items.exampleZh: 我老闆把草稿退回來，上面寫滿了紅字。

items.sentenceEn: Please send the signed form back electronically by Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 請在星期五前以電子方式寄回簽好的表格。

items.audioEn: I usually browse the news on my phone during my morning train ride.
items.audioZh: 我通常在早上搭火車時用手機瀏覽新聞。
items.questionZh: 說話者通常什麼時候看新聞？
options: On the train home at night
Before the morning news on TV

items.sentenceEn: The presenter of the cooking show always starts with a joke.
items.sentenceZh: 那個烹飪節目的主持人總是用一個笑話開場。

items.sentenceEn: I think this cable is broken, because the screen keeps going black.
items.sentenceZh: 我想這條線壞了，因為螢幕一直變黑。

items.stemEn: Please read my ____ and tell me what to change before I send the final version.
items.stemZh: 請看看我的草稿，在我寄出最終版本之前告訴我要改什麼。

items.stemEn: The band used social media to ____ their new concert.
items.stemZh: 那個樂團用社群媒體宣傳他們的新演唱會。

items.passageEn: Mia is a presenter on a small online radio show. Last month, her team wanted to publicize a new program about local food. Mia wrote the first draft of the announcement on her desktop computer at work, and her manager made a few changes. Then the team looked at data about their audience and found that most of them were young people who browse the internet late at night. So they decided to share the news online after nine p.m. They also sent the announcement electronically to several newspapers. On the first night of the program, a cable in the studio stopped working, but someone fixed it within minutes, and the show started as scheduled.
items.passageZh: Mia 是一個小型網路電台節目的主持人。上個月，她的團隊想宣傳一個介紹在地美食的新節目。Mia 在辦公室的桌上型電腦上寫了公告的初稿，她的經理做了一些修改。接著團隊查看聽眾的資料，發現大多數聽眾是深夜會上網瀏覽的年輕人。所以他們決定晚上九點後在網路上分享這個消息。他們也以電子方式把公告寄給幾家報社。節目播出的第一晚，錄音室裡的一條線壞了，但有人在幾分鐘內就修好了，節目照預定時間開始。

questions.questionZh: 資料顯示他們的聽眾大多是什麼人？
節目第一晚發生了什麼事？
options: 主持人生病不能上節目了

items.promptZh: 這份報告的數據顯示，越來越多人在網路上買書。
referenceEn: The data in this report shows that more and more people buy books online.
According to the data in this report, more people are buying books online.
rubricZh: data 指數據，動詞單複數皆可（例如 the data shows、the data show 等）
「越來越多人」可寫，例如 more and more people、more people 等
時態配合內容（例如 buy、are buying 等）

items.promptZh: 我們在那家二手書店逛了一個小時。
referenceEn: We browsed in that second-hand bookshop for an hour.
We spent an hour browsing in that used bookstore.
rubricZh: browse 指隨意翻看、逛（例如 browse in a bookshop、browse the shelves 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 browsed、have browsed 等）
「二手書店」可寫，例如 second-hand bookshop、used bookstore 等
